incapacity_continuity_plan.title: Incapacity Continuity Plan
incapacity_continuity_plan.intro: Prepare a clear handoff when an adult is alive but unable to act.
incapacity_continuity_plan.caution: Keep the record factual and specific. Do not imply that this form creates legal authority or replaces professional documents.
incapacity_continuity_plan.empty: No incapacity continuity plan records have been prepared yet. Add the information that would help another person understand what exists, who to contact, and what supporting records to locate.
